function.name: git_commit
function.description: Stage modified/new files and record changes to the repository.

all.description: Stage all modified and deleted files before committing (-a)

function.name: ollama_status
function.description: Check whether Ollama is installed and running, retrieve server info, response latency, loaded VRAM models, and available models.

function.name: ollama_start
function.description: Start the Ollama server (ollama serve) as a background process managed by NARU. It will be automatically stopped when NARU exits.

auto_install.description: Auto-install Ollama if not present before starting (default: true)

function.name: ollama_stop
function.description: Stop the Ollama server process.

force_all.description: Force stop all Ollama instances even if not spawned by NARU (default: false)

function.name: ollama_install
function.description: Download and install Ollama for the host operating system (Linux, macOS, Windows).

function.name: ollama_ps
function.description: List models currently active/loaded in GPU VRAM or system RAM on the Ollama server.

function.name: run_shell
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its output (stdout + stderr). Use sparingly; prefer specialised tools like maven_compile when available.

working_dir.description: Directory to run the command in (defaults to project dir)

function.name: routine_run
function.description: Requests the agent to start executing a specified script. The script will run sequentially line by line.

routine_name.description: Name of the routine to run.

function.name: routine_add_line
function.description: Adds or updates a numbered line in a naru routine (internal REPL buffer). This is NOT a shell command or external script. Supports comments: use '#', '//', or 'REM' at the start (e.g., line=15, content='# Validate input'). Comments get line numbers for ordering but are skipped during execution. If routine_name is empty, uses the currently active routine.

routine_name.description: Name of the routine to modify. If empty, uses the currently active routine.

line_number.description: Line number to write (e.g. 10, 20,100). Supports gaps for easy insertion.

command.description: The instruction, condition, or loop directive to store at this line.

function.name: maven_compile
function.description: Compile a Maven project using 'mvn compile'. Returns compiler output and exit code.

project_dir.description: Path to the Maven project (defaults to agent project dir)

function.name: maven_test
function.description: Run Maven tests using 'mvn test'. Optionally run a single test class.

project_dir.description: Path to the Maven project (defaults to agent project dir)

test_class.description: Specific test class to run, e.g. 'com.example.MyTest' (optional)

function.name: maven_package
function.description: Package a Maven project using 'mvn package -DskipTests'. Returns build output and exit code.

project_dir.description: Path to the Maven project (defaults to agent project dir)

function.name: think
function.description: Use this tool to think through something privately before answering or acting. It performs no action and returns no result; use it for planning, reviewing tool output, verifying assumptions, or deciding the next step.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read contents of a text file. If line constraints are provided, it performs a strict logical 'AND' to slice the exact line range (0-indexed or 1-indexed depending on preference, standardizing on 1-based here). Omitting bounds reads from line 1 up to a safe threshold (2000 lines).

line_start.description: First line to read (1-based, optional, defaults to 1)

line_end.description: Last line to read (inclusive, optional, defaults to start + 2000)

function.name: file_write
function.description: Write content to a file, creating it (and any parent directories) if necessary. Overwrites existing content.

path.description: Destination file path (absolute or relative to project dir)

dry.description: If true, preview changes without modifying the file

function.name: file_append
function.description: Append to the end of the file. If the file (and its path) does not exist, it will be created.

path.description: Path of the file to append to

dry.description: If true, preview changes without modifying the file

function.name: file_edit_lines
function.description: Insert, replace, or delete lines in a text file. Supports 0-based indexing and negative indices (-1 = last line, -2 = second-to-last). Use dry=true to preview changes without writing.

from.description: Start line index (0-based inclusive, supports negatives)

to.description: End line index (0-based exclusive). Omit or equal to 'from' to insert.

content.description: New lines (\n separated). Leave empty to delete.

dry.description: If true, preview changes without modifying the file

function.name: file_edit_search_replace
function.description: Search for an exact string in a text file and replace it with new content. Optionally specify occurrence number (1-based, default 1). Use dry=true to preview changes without writing.

replaceAll.description: Replace all occurrences of search string (default false)

dry.description: If true, preview changes without modifying the file

function.name: file_create
function.description: Create a new file with specified content. Fails if file already exists unless overwrite=true.

function.name: file_grep
function.description: Search for lines in a text file matching a pattern. Supports literal and regex search with surrounding context.

path.description: File or directory to search (optional, defaults to current working directory)

include.description: File pattern to include in the search (e.g. *.js, *.java)

function.name: diff
function.description: Compare two text files and return their differences. Useful for comparing .ntx source files or checking what changed between versions.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around each change (default: 3).

function.name: pwd
function.description: return current working dir

function.name: folder_find
function.description: Find files by name/glob patterns and optionally search their contents. CRITICAL: A strict logical 'AND' is performed across ALL filters. Files must simultaneously match: Location Path AND Glob Filters (include/exclude) AND Time Window Constraints (modified_after/before) AND Content Text Pattern (if provided). Only files satisfying EVERY layer of this constraint chain are processed.

content_pattern.description: Search text pattern inside file contents (optional)

include_filename.description: Glob patterns to include file by name (comma-separated, e.g. '*.java,*.xml')

exclude_filename.description: Glob patterns to exclude file by name (comma-separated, e.g. '*.java,*.xml')

function.name: cd
function.description: update working dir and return the absolute path. when no argument, switches to project directory

work_dir.description: Path to the change to, can be relative (to session workdir) or absolute. when empty, return to project dir

function.name: web_search
function.description: search the web for the provided query

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetches content from a specified URL and converts it to requested format (markdown, text, or html). Defaults to markdown.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

format.description: The format to return the content in (markdown, text, or html). Defaults to markdown.
